items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Only did a couple of things with Lester Lanin

ctx.x: Did you put in time with Lester Lanin too?

Naw, I did a couple -- (laughs). Only did a couple of things with Lester Lanin, but man, this will kill you. Jonah Jones, you know, when Jonah -- I told you we were friends years ago, and both of us starving to death, and he got a break, and so I ran into him, and I said look, throw some jobs my way. Give me a crumb or two. He said 'Okay, go down and see Lester Lanin and tell him I sent you.' And you get hooked up with this guy you've got a

chance to do two or three or four things a night, you know, a shot here, a shot there, and they'd take you in a car, and they'd bring you round, so I said oh, that'd be fine. So I went down to see Lester, and told him, My name's Herman Autrey, and Jonah Jones asked me to come down, and blah, blah, blah, blah. He said well, fine. Who'd you play with?
